about_short_description.short_description: Foundation 2 is a not-for-profit human service agency.

product.name: Crisis Services
product.description: Free, 24/7 support for anyone experiencing a mental health or suicide-related situation or concern, available via phone, text, chat, and in-person.

product.name: Crisis Phone Line
product.description: 24/7 phone support for individuals in crisis, providing immediate assistance and counseling.

product.name: Crisis Text & Chat
product.description: Free text and chat services available Monday through Friday from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. for individuals seeking support.

product.name: Mobile Crisis Outreach
product.description: On-site crisis counseling available 24/7, where counselors can visit homes, workplaces, or public places to provide support.

product.name: Prevention Education
product.description: Community and workplace trainings and education opportunities focused on suicide prevention.

product.name: Youth Support
product.description: Temporary safe and nurturing environment for teens needing to live away from home due to personal or family crises, along with connections to additional services.
